definitions.gloss: stadiometer; height meter; height measuring device
definitions.explanation: A device used to measure a person's height, typically a vertical ruler with a sliding horizontal arm that rests on the top of the head. Found in schools, clinics, hospitals, and sometimes in homes, especially for tracking children's growth.

examples.japanese: {身長計|しんちょうけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保健室|ほけんしつ}→保健室：05380_hokenshitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身長計|しんちょうけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

examples.english: At a health checkup, you first stand in front of the stadiometer and have your height measured.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧ (height, stature) and the suffix ⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧ (measuring device). Refers specifically to a device that measures standing height; for weight, the equivalent is ⟦{体重計|たいじゅうけい}→体重計：05485_taijuukei⟧.

USAGE:
Standard equipment in Japanese school health offices (⟦{保健室|ほけんしつ}→保健室：05380_hokenshitsu⟧) and clinics, where annual height and weight measurements are part of routine checkups. Home versions are common in families with young children.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身長計|しんちょうけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure with a stadiometer
- {身長計|しんちょうけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand in front of the stadiometer
- ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧{身長計|しんちょうけい}: home-use stadiometer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{体重計|たいじゅうけい}→体重計：05485_taijuukei⟧: bathroom scale — measures weight, the natural counterpart
- ⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧⟦{計測器|けいそくき}→計測器：26432_keisokuki⟧: height measuring device — a more technical synonym
- ⟦メジャー→メジャー：11595_mejaa⟧: tape measure — flexible measuring tape, used for body circumference rather than height
